```{r, load saved models}
rds_dir <- knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir")
rds_files <- file.path(rds_dir, c("rq1_temporal_models_byrep.rds", "rq1_temporal_models_avg.rds"))
missing_rds <- rds_files[!file.exists(rds_files)]
if (length(missing_rds) > 0) {
  stop("Saved models not found: ", paste(basename(missing_rds), collapse = ", "),
       ". Run RQ1-temporal_byrep.qmd and RQ1-temporal_avg.qmd first.")
}

rq1_models <- c(readRDS(rds_files[1]), readRDS(rds_files[2]))
rq1_models <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rq1_models)

# glmmTMB models read back from disk lose their compiled-code pointer.
# Summary-type output works regardless; if your glmmTMB version has
# up2date(), use it to restore the models fully.
if ("up2date" %in% getNamespaceExports("glmmTMB")) {
  rq1_models <- lapply(rq1_models, function(m) if (inherits(m, "glmmTMB")) glmmTMB::up2date(m) else m)
}

list2env(rq1_models, envir = globalenv())
names(rq1_models)

rq1_img_dir <- "C:/Users/savan/OneDrive - San Francisco State University/ProjectData/GitHub/DepositionSFB/images/rq_1"

# save_glmm_tables() needs both <model> and <model>_avg. This wrapper
# skips (with a message) any model that's missing a tier, instead of
# stopping the whole render.
save_glmm_tables_available <- function(model_list, out_dir) {
  has_both <- vapply(names(model_list), function(m)
    exists(m, envir = globalenv()) && exists(paste0(m, "_avg"), envir = globalenv()),
    logical(1))
  if (any(!has_both)) {
    message("Skipping (not saved in both tiers): ",
            paste(names(model_list)[!has_both], collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (any(has_both)) save_glmm_tables(model_list[has_both], out_dir = out_dir)
}
```

```{r, GLMM output tables}
# One image per GLMM, for both tiers: <model>_byrep.png and <model>_avg.png
# (same layout as the RQ1-spatial tables). The lmer() SENSITIVITY versions
# (edge_time_model, edge_time_model_noGM, edge_phenperiod_model,
# edge_season_model) are Gaussian, not GLMMs, so they're left out.

rq1_temporal_glmms <- list(
  edge_time_model_glmm       = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x month",
  edge_time_model_glmm_ar1   = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x month, AR1 temporal autocorrelation",
  edge_phenperiod_model_glmm = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x phenological period",
  edge_season_model_glmm     = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x calendar season"
)

save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_temporal_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)

# ADDED: distance GLMMs (each has an _avg twin, as save_glmm_tables expects)
rq1_distance_glmms <- list(
  dist_time_model_glmm          = "Flux ~ log distance x month",
  dist_season_model_glmm        = "Flux ~ log distance x calendar season",
  dist_season_model_glmm_factor = "Flux ~ distance (factor) x calendar season",
  edge_dist_season_model_glmm   = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x log distance x calendar season"
)
save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_distance_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)

# ADDED: sensitivity refits. If save_glmm_tables_available() doesn't handle the
# dispformula model, drop edge_season_model_glmm_disp from this list --
# its comparison is already covered by edge_season_sensitivity_*.png.
rq1_sensitivity_glmms <- list(
  edge_season_model_glmm_tran   = "Edge type x season, + transect random effect",
  edge_season_model_glmm_disp   = "Edge type x season, seasonal dispersion",
  edge_season_model_glmm_noGM   = "Edge type x season, excluding GiantMarsh",
  edge_season_model_glmm_noDec  = "Edge type x season, excluding December",
  edge_season_model_glmm_noFlag = "Edge type x season, excluding flagged long intervals",
  edge_season_model_glmm_interval = "Edge type x season, + deployment length covariate"
)
save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_sensitivity_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)

# ADDED: site differences (no edge-type term; see "Site differences")
rq1_site_glmms <- list(
  site_season_model_glmm = "Flux ~ site x calendar season (site as fixed effect)"
)
save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_site_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)

# ADDED: wind GLMMs. edge_time_gam is an mgcv gam, not a glmmTMB model,
# so it's left out of save_glmm_tables_available() -- its summary() output in the
# GAM chunk is the table to report.
rq1_wind_cont_glmms <- list(
  phase_base_wind_cont_glmm = "Flux ~ marsh edge type, study phase random effect (no wind; continuous-wind rows)",
  mean_wind_model_glmm      = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x mean wind speed (kt), study phase random effect",
  gust_model_glmm           = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x maximum gust (kt), study phase random effect",
  wind_cat_model_glmm       = "Flux ~ marsh edge type x Beaufort category of mean wind speed, study phase random effect"
)
save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_wind_cont_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)
```
